tool_compressor_desc: Reduce image file size instantly with adjustable compression quality.
tool_video_cutter_desc: Slice local video clips precisely with a touch-friendly timeline and timestamp controls.

video_cutter.title: Video Cutter
video_cutter.desc: A precise client-side tool that allows content creators to slice and cut local video files instantly using an interactive timeline slider or manual timestamp fields.

tool_video_merger_desc: Combine multiple clips into one seamless output with mobile-optimized drag reorder controls.

video_merger.title: Video Merger
video_merger.desc: Combines multiple video clips into one cohesive video file locally, featuring canvas auto-scaling and visual reordering controls optimized for touch screens.

tool_video_compressor_desc: Compress large videos in the browser with CRF scaling tuned for social media limits.

video_compressor.title: Video Compressor
video_compressor.desc: Reduces large video file sizes in the browser using custom CRF scaling, targeting specific social media network limits without destroying key visual quality.

tool_watermark_adder_desc: Brands user videos client-side by watermarking them with highly adjustable textual markers or geometric brand images using precise placement offsets.

watermark_adder.title: Watermark Adder
watermark_adder.desc: Apply a local watermark to your videos with text or logo overlays and precise position offsets.
watermark_adder.error_invalid_video: Please select a valid video file.
watermark_adder.error_missing_video: Please upload a source video first.
watermark_adder.error_missing_text: Please enter watermark text or select a watermark image.
watermark_adder.error_processing: Watermark processing failed. Try a different file or reposition the overlay.

tool_video_converter_desc: Converts local videos into standard web formats or loops them into high-performance animated GIFs with frame-rate and scaling optimization options.

video_converter.title: Format & GIF Converter
video_converter.desc: Converts local videos into standard web formats or loops them into high-performance animated GIFs with frame-rate and scaling optimization options.
video_converter.error_conversion: Conversion failed. Please try another file or format.

tool_video_reverser_desc: Reverses video play order local-side to create captivating rewind loop effects, offering dedicated modes to handle the accompanying audio track sync.

video_reverser.title: Video Reverser
video_reverser.desc: Reverses video play order local-side to create captivating rewind loop effects, offering dedicated modes to handle the accompanying audio track sync.
video_reverser.error_conversion: Video reversal failed. Please try a different file.

tool_speed_changer_desc: Speeds up or slows down locally imported videos with sub-decimal accuracy, utilizing real-time audio pitch adjustments to keep voices sounding crisp.

speed_changer.title: Video Speed Controller
speed_changer.desc: Speeds up or slows down locally imported videos with sub-decimal accuracy, utilizing real-time audio pitch adjustments to keep voices sounding crisp.
speed_changer.pitch_lock_desc: Preserves voice clarity when changing speed
speed_changer.pitch_lock_help: Adjusts audio pitch to maintain natural voice tone regardless of speed changes
speed_changer.preset_desc: Choose from common speed options: 0.5x for slow-motion, 1.0x for normal, 1.5x for faster playback, and 2.0x for double-speed
speed_changer.range_desc: Adjust speed from 0.25x (quarter speed) to 4.0x (quadruple speed) with 0.05 increment precision
speed_changer.error_conversion: Speed adjustment failed. Please try a different file.

tool_audio_extractor_desc: Extracts audio tracks from video files locally into MP3 or WAV formats with bitrate control.

audio_extractor.title: Audio Extractor
audio_extractor.desc: Rips and extracts audio tracks directly out of video files locally, saving them into optimized formats like high-fidelity MP3 or lossless WAV.
